body.message:
Voici une version claire et ferme en anglais :

The apartment is incredibly dirty. There is hair all over the bed, and the overall cleanliness is completely unacceptable. I really do not like dirt and unhygienic conditions.

I want you to send a cleaning team today to thoroughly clean the apartment, remove all the cockroaches and insects, and replace all the bed sheets so that my wife and I can finally enjoy our stay.

If this is not possible, then please refund my money, as I will be leaving today. I absolutely cannot stay in these conditions. Cleanliness is extremely important to me, and this situation is making me very uncomfortable.

Please let me know as soon as possible what solution you can offer. Thank you.
